text:
Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss is now confirmed. The current evidence (version 2, knowledge date 2026-11-12) is marked SUPPORTED. Hansen/UMD maps about 4.5 ha of loss in 2023, roughly 0.12% of the 3,643.5 ha property. Later years of the series, through 2025, were observed, and the JRC 2020 forest map agrees that the whole affected area was forest in 2020. An earlier version (June 2024) was only "pending corroboration" because no later year was available. It has been superseded.

What this does not show: the area is mapped as planted pine (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), so the loss may be plantation harvest rather than deforestation. The data do not establish deforestation or land-use change, the cause, legality, who was responsible, or any regulatory compliance status. An additional 1.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted.
